case.summary: The case was opened after a portfolio sweep flagged four online purchases of $400–$500 on card C01890-K1 within 27 minutes, totaling $1,921.59. Evidence shows the amounts are far above the card’s historical average, the pattern matches a known under-$500 structuring scheme seen on 11 other cards, and a prior investigation linked the card to fraud. The investigation concluded fraud with 99% probability, so the card was blocked, the transaction declined, the case was escalated to a fraud analyst, and a report was filed. The analyst confirmed the coordinated scheme and the case remains open for monitoring of connected cards.

The activity fits none of the bank's five documented fraud patterns. Authorization-threshold structuring: 4 online purchases on one card, each between $400 and $500, inside about 27 minutes, from more than one device. The amounts look chosen to stay just under a $500 authorization limit. The same run shape appears on 11 other cards in the surrounding weeks, so it is a repeated scheme across customers rather than one compromised card. The same scheme links to other cards, which have been placed under monitoring: C00466-K1, C02265-K1, C03633-K1, C05423-K1, C05766-K1, C05851-K1, C06881-K1, C07297-K1, C10751-K1, C10990-K1, C12641-K2.
